ask: When no video fits a person's language and app version, what should the help page show?
problem: The help page has no links to the tutorial videos. People cannot watch or download the video for the screen they are on.
found: Videos exist in 15 languages, with a stable download link and a watch link for each. The app links to none of them. Phones differ by store build and by update. A video filmed on today's screens can show buttons an older phone lacks.
changed: Nothing yet. Once you pick, the help page will show Watch and Download for the current screen. It will pick by the app's language and build.
why: The server will match the screen, the language and the build. Only the empty case is a product choice, so I ask first. I looked at hiding the link, showing English, opening the list, and showing a closest video with a warning.
touches: The videos page link, the video list the server keeps, and the help screens. No video is published or changed.

options.label: A. Hide the link
options.result: No match, no link. Clean page, but people never learn a video exists.

options.label: B. Show English, labelled
options.result: People get the English video, marked as English. With no video at all, the link is hidden.

options.label: C. Open the list
options.result: The link opens the full video list in their language. They choose by hand.

options.label: D. Closest video, with a warning
options.result: An older phone gets the newest video, marked as made for a newer app.
